name: weblens
description: Evidence-based website quality evaluator for lead scouting and design critique.

scripts.test:policies: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/scoring.test.js dist/tests/lead.test.js dist/tests/critic.test.js
scripts.eval:promptfoo: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfoo/promptfooconfig.yaml --no-cache
scripts.eval:promptfoo:pnj: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfoo/promptfooconfig.yaml --no-cache --output evals/promptfoo/results/pnj.json
scripts.eval:promptfoo:atad: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfoo/promptfooconfig.yaml --no-cache --output evals/promptfoo/results/atad.json
